about: GTA generations (Delta, pillar 3 GTA history). Take-Two press release Sept 18 2013 (SEC 8-K ex99.1): GTA V 'Launched on September 17 for the PlayStation 3 ... and the Xbox 360'. Sony release Nov 15 2013: PS4 launched in the US and Canada that day. Take-Two product tables (SEC): GTA V Xbox One, PS4 November 18, 2014 (Oct 29 2014 and Feb 3 2015 releases); PC planned January 27, 2015 (Oct 29 2014 table), then March 24, 2015 (Feb 3 2015 table), then April 14, 2015 (May 2015 release table) = two date moves. Take-Two Q4 FY22 release (May 16 2022): 'On March 15th, Rockstar Games launched Grand Theft Auto V digitally on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S'. GTA VI: Take-Two Q2 FY27 release (Nov 9 2026) lineup 'Grand Theft Auto VI PS5, Xbox Series X|S November 19, 2026'; rockstargames.com/VI 'Coming November 19, 2026', PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S. Pre-launch as of 2026-11-17. No PC claim for GTA 6 beyond 'Rockstar has announced PS5 and Xbox Series X|S'. No 'one of few games' claim. Sources in BRIEF.md.
